title: Multi-Agent Memory Inconsistency: Where Factual Conflicts Disappear in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.22245v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multi-agent delegation lets LLM systems distribute evidence collection across workers with separate contexts. This creates a consistency challenge: facts retrieved by workers may be missing from the evidence available to the lead for a joint conclusion. We introduce a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for studying multi-agent memory inconsistency through controlled factual conflicts in Harvey LAB document-review tasks. Pooled across three models with comparable generation spending, requiring delegation increases retrieval of both conflicting claims from 50.2% to 68.7% relative to single-agent execution, yet conflict detection falls from 16.2% to 13.2%. Within this setting, workers report both claims for only 35.2% of retrieved pairs, and pooled matched comparisons show higher detection than single-agent execution when one worker reads both claims but lower detection when the claims are split across workers. translated_title: 多智能体记忆不一致性：LLM智能体中事实冲突消失之处
translated_abstract: 多智能体委托使LLM系统能够将证据收集任务分配给拥有各自独立上下文的多个工作智能体。这带来了一致性挑战：工作智能体检索到的事实可能无法出现在主导智能体用于形成联合结论的证据之中。我们引入了一个基准测试和证据流分析器，通过在Harvey LAB文档审查任务中植入受控的事实冲突来研究多智能体记忆不一致性。在三个模型上汇总、生成开销相当的情况下，相比单智能体执行，要求委托使两条冲突声明的检索率从50.2%提升到68.7%，然而冲突检测率却从16.2%下降到13.2%。在此设置中，工作智能体仅在35.2%的检索到的冲突对中同时报告两条声明；汇总的匹配比较显示，当同一工作智能体读到两条冲突声明时，检测率高于单智能体执行，而当冲突声明分散在不同工作智能体之间时，检测率则低于单智能体执行。（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一个基准测试与证据流分析器来研究多智能体LLM系统中的记忆不一致问题，发现委托虽然提高了冲突事实的检索率（50.2%→68.7%），却反而降低了冲突检测率（16.2%→13.2%），且当冲突信息分散在不同工作智能体的独立上下文中时检测效果最差。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a benchmark and evidence-flow profiler for multi-agent memory inconsistency, showing that delegation increases retrieval of conflicting claims (50.2%→68.7%) yet reduces conflict detection (16.2%→13.2%), with detection dropping further when conflicting claims are split across separate worker contexts.
